about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: From bare ground on 2026-02-25 to today
about.intro: This used to be an overgrown empty lot. We photographed all six months of construction — not for show, but so you know that every fishing spot, every light and every stone here was really built.
about.step1Text: We had just taken over the land. The weeds stood taller than a person.
about.step2Text: Three days of digging to cut out the outline of both ponds.
about.step3Text: Stone gabions laid and levelled so the water settles and the banks hold.
about.step4Text: Laid stone by stone — the edge of the pond finally appears.
about.step5Text: The steel frame goes up; this is where the kitchen and pavilions would stand.
about.step6Text: Roof on. Seen from across the water, it starts to look like a fishing pond.
about.step7Text: Walls, floors, doors and windows done — water and power next.
about.step8Text: The first night we ran the lights all night, we realised the pond looks better after dark.
about.step9Text: Walkway lighting switched on; pavilions and dining room lit.
about.step10Text: The scale moved to the counter — the first fish weighed and taken home.
about.step11Text: First whole grilled fish goes out.
about.step12Text: Rod wall, bar and tables are all in place. All that's missing is you.
about.ctaText: The photos cover six months; the pond is alive. Pick an evening and fish a session.
